title: Poop Emoji Cookies
description: These easy 3-D poop emoji cookies baked from scratch are decorated with sugar eyes and are sure to delight emoji-obsessed kids and adults.
ingredients: 2 teaspoons lemon juice, or as needed

steps.text: Combine flour, 1 cup confectioners' sugar, 3/4 cup plus 2 tablespoons cocoa powder, baking powder, vanilla sugar, and salt in a large bowl. Work in butter with your fingers until mixture resembles small crumbs. Add milk and egg; knead into a soft dough. Place in a bowl, cover, and refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C). Line 2 baking sheets with parchment paper.

Roll dough into long, thin 8-inch ropes, pinching one end into a pointy tip. Arrange in the shape of a little poop-mound with the pointy tip on top; place onto the prepared baking sheet, leaving space between individual cookies.
Bake in the preheated oven until lightly darkened on the bottom and dried, 10 to 12 minutes. Carefully remove from baking sheet and transfer onto a wire rack to cool completely, about 2 hours.
Mix 3 tablespoons confectioners' sugar with lemon juice to form a thin icing. Glue 2 candy eyeballs on each poop cookie and let dry.

video.description: Nothing is more fun than these cookies shaped like emojis! Bring them to your next gathering for some laughs. The chocolate cookies with sugar eyeballs are sure to inspire the creative bakers in the bunch as well as be a delicious hit!
